bd-h4fc CLOSED. Commit 99f4986 on flywheel main (src/builtin_workflows.rs only; other lanes uncommitted files untouched). Bead tracker synced + committed c3fd7ea on toron main.

EVIDENCE:
- 16/16 builtin tests green (11 existing + 6 new); clippy-clean on this file (7 pre-existing clippy errors in intent.rs/pane.rs/main.rs are other lanes, untouched).
- Fixed 5 bugs in the 5 built-ins + hardened onboard/triage-deep:
  1. Dead spec.prompt key (headless dispatch reads task/stage) - brainstorm.diverge + debate.briefs now spec.task with inputs.question/inputs.proposal.
  2. reduce/decide decided blind - tasks now consume steps.diverge / steps.briefs (ADR-0005 Spec 2b parity).
  3. triage ack rendered empty - trigger.subject not in message_posted payload; now trigger.content (ack) + trigger.id (dispatch).
  4. goal chain: build/review got generic base prompt; ship called triage whose invoke-path templates render empty. Now build=systematic-execute+steps.track, review=code-review+steps.build (harness opencode kept), ship=commit-and-push+steps.build.
  5. onboard/triage-deep were disconnected dispatches - seed now gets steps.map, prioritize steps.triage, spawn steps.prioritize via spec.plan.
- Guards: on_error: fail_run on 12 decisive steps (reduce/decide/decompose/create/build/review/ship + map/seed/triage/prioritize/spawn + plan-review.review).
- crew: auto preserved on all 8 purpose-named workflows; reviewer harness overrides intact; weekly-review untouched.
- NEW TESTS: fanout_outputs_reach_reducers, no_dispatch_spec_uses_dead_prompt_key, goal_carries_context_through_chain, decisive_steps_fail_run, triage_uses_resolvable_payload_fields, onboard_and_triage_deep_chain_outputs.

Reservations released (path clear). Dependent bd-e0xk (loop migration onto WorkflowEngine) unblocked.
